english.note: Use 培養 for deliberately fostering an interest, ability, or other personal quality.
Use this for deliberately developing a quality, habit, skill, or social attitude rather than feeding or financially supporting someone.

examples.english: I cultivate my interest in reading in my spare time.
examples.traditional: 我平時會培養自己嘅閱讀興趣。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 ping4 si4 wui5 pui4 joeng5 zi6 gei2 ge3 jyut6 duk6 hing3 ceoi3

examples.english: My dad helped nourish my interest in music from an early age.
examples.traditional: 爸爸由細培養我對音樂嘅興趣。
examples.jyutping: baa4 baa4 jau4 sai3 pui4 joeng5 ngo5 deoi3 jam1 ngok6 ge3 hing3 ceoi3
